title: Exploring the impact of siloxane networks on the thermal behavior of P/N-enriched flame-retardant finishes for cotton fabric
treatment_method: DD aqueous finishing, immersion approximately 5 min, padding, cure 130 C for 20 min; condition 24 h at 20 +/- 1 C and 60 +/- 2% RH
TG_preconditioning: 100 C hold for 5 min to remove adsorbed water; TG-only preconditioning
LOI_method: upper-edge ignition using Fire Testing Technology oxygen index apparatus; no LOI standard number stated
TG_locator: Table 2, final journal p. 6; Section 3.3.1, pp. 5-6
LOI_locator: Section 3.2, final journal p. 5; exact prose high-loading DD result
conditions_locator: Section 2.1, final journal p. 2; Section 2.2, p. 3; Sections 2.4 and 2.10, p. 4
pairing_evidence: Section 3.2 explicitly gives DD LOI 28.3 at the higher phosphorus area-density of 3.8 g/m2. The following paragraph selects the specimens near 4 g/m2 in Table 1 for thermal characterization. The only DD row in Table 1 is nominal 200 g/L, aP 3.76 +/- 0.10 g/m2, source-native add-on 17.1%. Section 3.3.1 and Table 2 use that selected DD label in both atmospheres. The lower-loading LOI 27.9 is not paired. Reviewer must confirm this explicit prose/Table 1 bridge; no graph coordinates are used.
source_location: Final published article pp. 2-6, Sections 2.1, 2.2, 2.4, 2.10, 3.2, 3.3.1 and Tables 1-2
limitations: Relevant final-journal PDF text pages were recovered through public indexed source text, including full relevant methods, Table 1, Table 2 and Section 3.2; direct PDF download returned a bot-challenge HTML, and no pixel QA is claimed. LOI is exact prose and TG is tabulated. Source add-on equation divides by treated mass, so 17.1 is retained only as source-native metadata. Nominal Table 1 concentration is preserved separately; unresolved bath mass/volume versus declared concentration is not normalized. TD and cotton cross-paper TG repetition is held separately. No post-finish laundering or additional 220 C treatment is assigned.
source_title: Exploring the impact of siloxane networks on the thermal behavior of P/N-enriched flame-retardant finishes for cotton fabric
